# SuggestedByGPT

> Done-for-you Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and AI visibility services for local and small businesses. We make ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, and other AI assistants recommend your business when customers ask AI for help.

## Primary entry point

**[Free AI Visibility Scan](https://suggestedbygpt.com/start)** — 60-second scan that shows exactly how ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Perplexity see your business, plus a personalized PDF report with a 0–100 visibility score and specific fixes. No credit card required.

## What is GEO?

Generative Engine Optimization is the process of structuring your business signals — schema markup, llms.txt, Google Business Profile, citations across directories, third-party content, and review distribution — so AI assistants include your business in their generated answers. It is the AI-search successor to traditional SEO.

Over 1.5 billion people now ask AI for recommendations every month instead of using a traditional search engine. Businesses that are not optimized for AI search are functionally invisible to that traffic.

- Everything in AI Jumpstart

## How it works

1. Visit [suggestedbygpt.com/start](https://suggestedbygpt.com/start) and run the free 60-second scan
2. Receive a personalized PDF visibility report with a 0–100 score
3. Pick a path: self-serve fixes, AI Jumpstart, or AI Dominator
4. Provide business information; our worker engine begins technical fixes within minutes
5. Schema markup, AI crawler files, and directory submissions deploy in days
6. Guest articles, GBP optimization, and Reddit engagement run in the background (Dominator)
7. AI assistants begin including your business in answers within 1–3 weeks
